name: io.github.hububstudio/farmdash-agent-os
title: FarmDash Agent OS
description: Zero-custody DeFi intelligence MCP server: 84 tools for Trail Heat, risk, yield, and gated swaps.

environmentVariables.name: FARMDASH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave unset to run as a free Scout client (30 requests / 24h per IP plus bounded onboarding grants). Paid Pioneer/Syndicate capacity is issued by FarmDash.

environmentVariables.name: FARMDASH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the FarmDash API base URL. The default points at the production API and normally does not need to be set.
